items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Clifford and Bobby Burton, a little bass player from there, they used to stop by and stand outside with their books

ctx.x: Well anyhow, at that time that’s when I met Clifford Brown when I was with the Hollis Hoppers down there at a matinee at the Ritz Bar. And Clifford and Bobby Burton, a little bass player from there, they used to stop by and stand outside with their books, and Brownie, he had his horn with him, they had a little band practice and what not, and he’s a very shy kid, you know, Clifford. And he said [softly], “I’m gonna play jazz, too.”
He was a teenager at this point, right?
